name: Ano Biidama o Wasurenai
original_name: あのビー玉を忘れない
source:
You're just a regular girl. One day, you see a man inside a glass marble you bought.

You're transported into another world, and while fighting villains, you get to meet beautiful men...

[translated from [url=http://lightbreeze.ivory.ne.jp/game/anobi.htm]official website[/url]]
